# glinet_repeater_status (Data Source)

Get the state of the repeater, the Wi-Fi uplink of the router (`repeater.get_status`). The data source does not put the Wi-Fi key, the EAP identity and the `wpa_status` values of the uplink network in the state. The values change while the router runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glinet_repeater_status" "uplink" {}

output "repeater_uplink" {
  value = data.glinet_repeater_status.uplink.state == "connected" ? data.glinet_repeater_status.uplink.ssid : null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `band` (String) Band of the uplink, for example `2g` or `5g`. Null when the router gives no band.
- `bare_mode` (Boolean) Whether the repeater is in the captive portal login mode of the web UI (`bare_mode`).
- `bssid` (String) BSSID of the access point of the uplink network. Null when the router gives no BSSID.
- `channel` (Number) Wi-Fi channel of the uplink. Null when the router gives no channel.
- `connected` (String) Time since the repeater connected, as the router gives it (`connected`), for example `40m,13s`. Null when the router gives no time.
- `device` (String) Radio of the repeater (`device`), for example `radio0`. Null when the router gives no radio.
- `dfs` (Boolean) Whether the channel of the uplink is a DFS channel (`dfs`).
- `eap` (Boolean) Whether the uplink network uses enterprise (EAP) authentication (`eap`). This value comes from the web UI code and was not seen on a router.
- `fail_type` (String) Reason of the last failed connection (`fail_type`), for example `key` (wrong key) or `not-found` (network not found). Null when the router gives no reason.
- `htmode` (String) HT mode of the uplink (`htmode`), for example `HT40`. Null when the router gives no HT mode.
- `ipv4` (Attributes) IPv4 address of the uplink (`ipv4`). Null when the router gives no IPv4 address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the repeater interface (`macaddr`). Null when the router gives no MAC address.
- `network` (String) Network interface of the repeater (`network`), for example `wwan`. Null when the router gives no interface.
- `portal` (Boolean) Whether the uplink network has a captive portal (`portal`).
- `portal_url` (String) URL of the captive portal (`portal_url`). This value comes from the web UI code and was not seen on a router. Null when the router gives no URL.
- `protocol` (String) Address protocol of the uplink network (`protocol` of `config`): `dhcp` or `static`. Null when the router gives no protocol.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the repeater runs (`running`).
- `signal` (Number) Signal strength of the uplink in dBm (`signal`). Null when the router gives no signal.
- `ssid` (String) SSID of the uplink network. Null when the repeater has no network.
- `state` (String) State of the repeater (`state_s`), for example `connected`, `connecting` or `failed`. Null when the router gives no state name, for example when the repeater is not connected.
- `state_code` (Number) State of the repeater as a number (`state`): `0` not connected and `2` connected. The router can give other values, for which the meaning is not known.

<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `dns` (List of String) DNS servers (`dns`).
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 gateway (`gateway`). Null when the router gives no gateway.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address with the prefix length (`ip`), for example `192.0.2.10/24`. Null when the router gives no address.
